description: Submit the dated figure you are about to act on. Returns verified, stale, contradicted or unknown, cited to the publisher's own series with its as-of date. Use before committing a number to a page, deck or decision. Not advice. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

claim.description: The assertion to check, e.g. 'The RBA cash rate is 4.35% as at August 2026'.

series_id.description: Optional. Name the series to bypass the rule-based router (see list_series). Use when you already know which series owns the number, or when routing was ambiguous.

name: check_figure
